component.name: NightManager
component.summary: Switch to night mode on a schedule

description.p: NightManager keeps a phone from disturbing your sleep. At the evening time it switches to the night settings you choose, and in the morning it puts your day settings back.

ul.li: Night Light, automatic brightness, dark style, accent color, GTK3 theme and icon theme
Quiet or Silent feedback
Per-day start and end times, or Night Light's own schedule
Start or end night mode early from the quick settings
The background service shows its status in the system's list of background apps
Times follow the system's 12- or 24-hour clock setting
Night Light's automatic schedule is shown as sunset and sunrise
A Night Light change waiting for the screen is no longer lost if the background service restarts first
The background service uses about 12 MB less memory on systems with transparent huge pages always on

description.p: Fixes for the app getting out of step with the background service.

ul.li: The Night Mode switch and status now update when night mode changes outside the app
Night Light, automatic brightness and feedback are applied when their service starts after night mode does
Choosing a picture no longer locks the window, and the picture on screen is never deleted
The Night Mode switch goes back and says so when the background service doesn't respond
Chosen pictures are used where they are instead of being copied, and shown by file name instead of a preview
Wallpaper and lock screen are no longer in Daytime Settings

description.p: Night mode can now change the wallpaper and the lock screen picture.

ul.li: The night wallpaper and lock screen can each be a picture or none
Daytime Settings can set the day wallpapers and lock screen picture too
Daytime Settings follows changes made elsewhere while it is open
The switch on the app icon is back to its full size

description.p: Night mode no longer overwrites your daytime settings.

ul.li: Settings are now read from the real system settings instead of an empty copy inside the sandbox, so the night choices and saved day values are correct
The background service refuses to run if it can't read back what it writes
New Daytime Settings dialog to set the values restored in the morning, or to change them directly
Quit and About in the main menu
New app icon and symbolic icon

description.p: First Flatpak release, replacing the script-based version.
